facts: Ancestor lookup follows only replyToRunId, bounded to eight turns, and stops at missing or repeated IDs and scope/source mismatches.
The reconciliation request is a read-only exact-run GET; it does not resubmit planner input or invoke actions.
Authoritative readback is merged into the existing run history; if it fails or mismatches, the ancestor recovery marker is retained and Apply is disabled while recovery is pending.
Apply is disabled globally while a pending recovery marker exists; the existing Check status and no-automatic-replay recovery copy remains.
A ready ancestor may remain independently applicable after an unrelated follow-up; the UI accepts the authoritative server status rather than assuming every descendant replaces its ancestor.
The receiving fixture covers an answer turn between a waiting plan and a follow-up edit and checks that the superseded plan has no Apply or Cancel controls.
